headline: Lending Industry Self-Regulation Ramps Up! Internet Loan Self-Regulation Preparatory Group to Expand, Focusing on Fund Diversion Risk
summary: China's internet loan self-regulation preparatory group is set to expand, with a focus on fund diversion risk, loans and audit. Du Xiaoman and the loan facilitation industry are named in the report.
why: Online lending platforms are regulated closely in China, and tighter self-regulatory standards affect fintech lenders and the credit market.
